title: Brown and McGraw, the dance act Louis Armstrong made famous
summary: Armstrong played every step of the dancers Brown and McGraw, whose act needed an ad-lib jazz trumpeter.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: That Louis Armstrong made these -- this couple famous, cause he played every step they made. And he screamed the whole act, playing trumpet, and every movement that they made, Louis would make it on his horn, and that made Brown and McGraw one of the most famous dance acts in Chicago, at that time. And Brown and McGraw, when they would travel, they would look for some trumpet player to play because without a trumpet player their act didn't mean a thing. And so they had to have a good adlib jazz trumpet player to play to their act, like Jabbo Smith or that type of trumpet
player who could play their act or else the act was lost.
